conviction_note: H1 will land far above the company's untouched H1 plan (Q1 alone was 65.7% of it), so a full-year raise at this print is more likely than not and peers that beat and raised (Yoshinoya, 10-09) were bought; but the IFIS consensus (OP 12.9bn) already sits above any plausible raise and the stock has faded 8% from its post-Q1 high, so the lean is modest: p_up 58 on a 4.2% scale gives +0.67, well under the +2.0 findings sum because most of the beat is computable from the Q1 短信 and the street bar is above the company's.
bar: Disputed. Company H1 plan OP 5,740m / FY OP 11,043m (Q1 短信 2026-07-13, unchanged: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260629583875.pdf); IFIS consensus FY OP 12,900m / RP 13,300m, unchanged for 4 weeks (https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=report&bcode=3087, 2026-10-09). print_vs_bar is my estimate of H1 OP (~6,800-7,100m) against an H1 run-rate implied by the IFIS FY number, roughly in line to slightly above; against the company H1 plan it would be about +20%. Coverage looks thin (one US broker note, neutral, TP 3,300, 2026-07-21), so findings resting on the bar are capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from sealed baseline). 信用倍率 3.09 (kabutan, 2026-10-13) - margin long moderately heavier than short, not a squeeze setup. No options, no skew. Run-up 20d -4.42%, 5d -1.10%; the stock ran 2,800 -> 3,425 after Q1 (07-13 to 09-01) and has faded ~8% since. priced_lean_pct -0.02 (flat).

findings.finding: Q1 (Mar-May) OP 3,770m was already 65.7% of the H1 OP plan of 5,740m (vs 51.8% and 54.1% at the same point the prior two years), so Q2 needs only 1,970m against 2,560m last year; the company itself wrote that Q1 'greatly exceeded plan' but kept the H1/FY plan, so H1 will print roughly 15-25% above the company's own H1 plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 vs plan is the line this stock trades on: H1 FY2026 landed below plan (2025-10-14) and the stock fell sharply ('大幅続落', baseline est. -4.47%); Q1 FY2027 beat (+35% OP) bought +4.71% on 07-14 and kept running to +22% over seven weeks.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: anyone can compute the progress rate from the Q1 短信 and the stock rallied 22% on it. What is not priced is the H1 headline itself ('上期経常は計画上振れ' on kabutan) landing on a retail register that sold last year's H1 miss hard; the 8% fade from the September high suggests some of the Q1 euphoria has come out. Sized small for that reason.
findings.independence: kabutan progress-rate table, same underlying numbers (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3087) - same document family, counts once.

findings.finding: The full-year plan (OP 11,043m) was left unchanged at Q1 despite the beat, and the company has revised mid-year before (FY2024.02 at Q1 and H1, FY2025.02 at Q1 and Q3); an H1 ~1.0-1.3bn above plan makes an upward FY revision at this print more likely than not, though any plausible raise (to ~12.0-12.4bn OP) still sits below the IFIS consensus of 12,900m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean H1 revision reaction in the sources I could reach; the Q1 beat without a raise was bought +4.7%. Peer read-through: Yoshinoya (same Feb year-end) beat H1 and raised FY on 2026-10-09 and the stock rose sharply ('大幅続伸').
findings.why_not_priced: A raise is not in the company number the stock's 17.4x PER is quoted on, and the stock has given back 8% since September. But the IFIS consensus (13,300m RP, +25%) already assumes far more than any raise is likely to deliver, so if the street bar is real a raise can disappoint - which is why the range runs negative and the size is capped.
findings.independence: IFIS consensus page (https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=report&bcode=3087) and Q1 短信 statement that FY plan unchanged despite the beat (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260629583875.pdf).

findings.finding: Q2 traffic slowed in Doutor's own 月次: chain same-store sales -0.4% (Jun), +3.0% (Jul), +3.6% (Aug) against +3.1%/+6.4% in Apr/May, with customer counts -2.3% in both June and August (typhoons and heavy rain cited), so Q2 profit growth will be slower than Q1's +35%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last year's Q1 slowdown (OP -6.5%) drew '大幅続落' on 2025-07-14; the series itself is published monthly and has not visibly moved the stock on its release days in the tape I checked.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the 月次 are public since 07-08, 08-13 and 09-09, and the stock has drifted down since September as they came out. The residual is wholesale (not in the 月次) and Nichires, which could make the Q2 deceleration look worse or better than the cafe series alone.
findings.independence: Same 月次 series for June and July (https://www.doutor.co.jp/about_us/ir/report/monthly/pdf/20260708142454.pdf, https://www.doutor.co.jp/about_us/ir/report/monthly/pdf/20260813123149.pdf) - one source, counts once.

findings.finding: Doutor raised prices across DCS/EXC from 2026-07-23 and its August 月次 says customer counts did not move materially after it, while arabica futures traded around $3.0-3.2/lb in early 2026 against 2025's highs - a margin tailwind for Q2-H2 on top of the Q1 margin of 8.9% (vs 7.1%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The price-hike notice itself (2026-07-01) was followed by a 3-session rebound noted by kabutan on 07-02; no print-level reaction history on margin specifically.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced (the hike was announced 07-01). Bean cost transmission is a proxy with hedging lags, so it is a small finding; what the market cannot see before the print is Q2 gross margin, and a 1pp margin hold vs Q1 would put Q2 OP well above last year's 2,560m.
findings.independence: Arabica price trend from a different source (https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/coffee/news/521311); price-revision notice (https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20260701/140120260701586052/).

findings.finding: Yoshinoya HD, a Feb-year-end Japanese restaurant chain reporting the same H1, beat its H1 and raised its full-year forecast on 2026-10-08/09 and rose sharply, which says the current tape pays for an H1 beat-and-raise in this sector.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Peer reaction, not this name's; included as a reaction-function proxy.
findings.why_not_priced: This is about the reaction, not the fact: it does not change what Doutor reports, only how a raise is likely to be received. Proxy, sized small.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Possible interim dividend increase or buyback announced with H1
rejected_candidates.detail: No document says one is coming; past dividend revisions were at Q3 (2026-01-14) and FY, buybacks with the FY print. Speculation only.

baseline_tension: Mild positive against a flat lean (-0.02) and a -4.4% 20-day run-up: the fade from 3,425 leaves room for a beat-and-raise, but the strongest negative - a raise that lands below the IFIS 12.9bn consensus, or a held FY plan citing costs as at Q1 - is real and was looked for; shorts are absent so there is no squeeze fuel, and margin longs at 3.09x would sell a disappointment.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on public 月次 is priced): the Q2 月次 slowdown finding shrunk from -0.4 to -0.2; p_up unchanged at 58 because the lean was already positive and did not rest on it.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): not triggered - four of five findings are positive; the strongest negative the release could carry (raise below consensus / FY held) is stated in baseline_tension.
Open question 4 (run-in as a short signal): not applicable; run-up is negative.
